notes.title: Hot Robot Launches 9-9-22!
notes.content: Playtesting is coming to an end 9-8-22 on account of the game comes out 9-9-22.  Thanks for giving the game a looksee!  If there's anything you'd like to see changed about the game it's not too late to let us know.  We'd like to continue making new maps and weapons while improving gameplay for future updates.  Thank you all again for your support in making this game happen!

notes.title: Limited test of Assembly Map
notes.content: Deathmatch will temporarily use Assembly Map. Lemme know whats up with the map on Reddit. r/hotrobot.

notes.title: Hit us up on Reddit!
notes.content: We're racing against the clock to make our dong-tossing weapons work smoothly.  Let us know if you broke our game, didn't like it or know some way it could be even more awesome.  Give us that sweet feedback on Reddit at r/hotrobot.
